title: 5 Hot Takes About the 2026 Black Canyon Ultras — Trailhead Media from UltraSignup
claims: The 2026 Black Canyon weekend drew nearly 2,000 total runners; the article reports 767 finishers in the 100K and 849 in the 50K.
Hans Troyer's 7:20:00 broke Seth Ruhling's 2025 course record of 7:24:55.
Jennifer Lichter's 7:57:05 broke Riley Brady's 2025 course record of 8:16:18.
Seth Ruhling won the 2026 50K in a course-record 3:16:29; Jane Maus won the women's 50K in 3:47:04.
The race dates back to 2014 and has become one of the top early-season 100K races in the world.

verification.note: UltraSignup Trailhead 2026-02-16 赛后分析；其 767/849 完赛数与 UltraSignup 官方成绩页 765/850、Aravaipa 汇总 1,626 均不完全一致，正文并列。
